Export descriptive analysis outputs to Excel

export_io_analysis.Rd

Writes all main results of the descriptive Input-Output analysis into a single Excel workbook. The workbook contains the following sheets:

Usage

export_io_analysis(
  sector,
  gdp_baseline,
  linkage_result,
  growth_rate,
  labour,
  OM,
  IM,
  LM,
  SUBM,
  land_proportion,
  landuse_table,
  linkage_table,
  full_io_table,
  code_registry,
  balance_detail,
  output_path = "data/IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx"
)

Arguments

gdp_baseline

Tibble returned by [calculate_gdp()].

linkage_result

List returned by [compute_linkage()].

growth_rate

Tibble or data frame of sectoral growth rates.

OM

Output from [calc_output_multiplier()].

IM

Output from [calc_income_multiplier()].

LM

Output from [calc_labour_multiplier()].

SUBM

Output from [calc_sub_multiplier()].

land_proportion

Numeric matrix of land proportions.

linkage_table

Tibble of linkage results (from [create_linkages_table()]).

full_io_table

Numeric matrix from [build_full_io_table()].

code_registry

Tibble from [build_full_io_table()].

balance_detail

Tibble from [check_io_balance()].

output_path

Character. Path to the output Excel file. Default is `"data/IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx"`.

Value

Invisibly returns the full path to the saved workbook.

Details

- `GDP`: GDP per sector table - `Leontief_Matrix`: Leontief inverse matrix - `Growth_Rate`: sectoral growth rates - `Multiplier_Output`, `Multiplier_Income`, `Multiplier_Labour`, `Multiplier_SUB`: multiplier tables - `Land_Proportion`: land proportion matrix - `Linkage`: linkage table (DBL, DFL, TBL, TFL, ITBL, ITFL) - `Full_IO_Table`: complete IO matrix (sectors + final demand + added value) - `Code_Registry`: code registry for modules that need cell-level changes - `Balance_Detail`: per-sector balance check table

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
export_io_analysis(
  gdp_baseline = gdp_baseline,
  linkage_result = linkage_result,
  growth_rate = growth_rate,
  OM = OM, IM = IM, LM = LM, SUBM = SUBM,
  land_proportion = land_proportion,
  linkage_table = linkages_table,
  full_io_table = full_io_table,
  code_registry = code_registry,
  balance_detail = balance_result$balance_detail,
  output_path = "data/IO_Analysis_Output.xlsx"
)
} # }
